bio: A historic address of the local area, with over 50 years of business, this rustic, welcoming restaurant offers an authentic, traditional atmosphere, with furnishings made of wood and local stone. The cuisine celebrates regional and Mediterranean flavors, with dishes prepared exclusively using ingredients sourced from local producers. During the warmer months, it's worth securing a table in the cool and shaded outdoor seating area, ideal for a relaxed lunch or dinner al fresco....
